01

“[This is] a release from God and His Messenger to those with whom…”

Three explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr, Saʿīd ibn Jubayr and Ibn Abī Awfā (Q 9:1).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
The shaykh, the imam, the just and trustworthy Abu Mansur Muhammad ibn Abd al-Malik ibn al-Hasan ibn Khayrun informed us, by recitation to him while I listened, and he affirmed it in Rajab of the year 538 [AH]; he said: Abu al-Fadl Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Khayrun informed us, by recitation to him while I listened, and he affirmed it in Shawwal of the year 432; he said: Abu Ali al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn Ibrahim ibn al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Shadhan informed us, by recitation to him; he said: Abu al-Qasim Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Ubayd, the judge of Hamadhan, informed me, by recitation to him; he said: Ibrahim ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Kisai related to us, saying: Adam ibn Abi Iyas related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words, Mighty and Majestic:
[This is] a release from God and His Messenger to those with whom you made a treaty among the polytheists [al-Tawba 1], meaning: "Khuzaa, Mudlij, and whoever had a treaty from among others. That is because the Messenger of God ﷺ returned from Tabuk when he had finished with it and wished to perform the hajj. Then he said: 'Polytheists attend the House and circumambulate the House naked, and I do not like to perform the hajj until I perform it with no polytheist with me.' So he sent Abu Bakr ibn Abi Quhafa and Ali ibn Abi Talib, and they went around among the people at Dhu al-Majaz and in all their places where they used to trade, and throughout the whole season, and announced to the people of the treaties that they were safe for four months, which are the sacred months that have elapsed in succession, ⦗p. 364⦘ twenty days from the end of Dhu al-Hijja to ten days left of Rabi al-Akhir, and that they had no treaty. And he announced war to all the people, unless they became secure [by believing]."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا الشَّيْخُ الْإِمَامُ الْعَدْلُ الثِّقَةُ أَبُو مَنْصُورٍ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ خَيْرُونَ، قِرَاءَةً عَلَيْهِ وَأَنَا أَسْمَعُ فَأَقَرَّ بِهِ فِي رَجَبٍ مِن سَنَةِ ثَمَانٍ وَثَلَاثِينَ وَخَمْسِمِائَةٍ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْفَضْلِ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ خَيْرُونَ قِرَاءَةً عَلَيْهِ وَأَنَا أَسْمَعُ فَأَقَرَّ بِهِ فِي شَوَّالٍ سَنَةَ اثْنَتَيْنِ وَثَلَاثِينَ وَأَرْبَعِمِائَةٍ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَلِيٍّ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ قِرَاءَةً عَلَيْهِ، قَالَ: أَنَا أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ الْقَاضِي الْهَمَذَانِيُّ، قِرَاءَةً عَلَيْهِ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ الْكِسَائِيُّ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ بْنُ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ فِي قَوْلِهِ عز وجل:
بَرَاءَةٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ إِلَى الَّذِينَ عَاهَدْتُمْ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ [التوبة: 1] ، يَعْنِي: " خُزَاعَةَ، وَمُدْلِجَ وَمَنْ كَانَ لَهُ عَهْدٌ مِنْ غَيْرِهِمْ وَذَلِكَ أَنَّهُ أَقْبَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مِنْ تَبُوكَ حِينَ فَرَغَ مِنْهَا فَأَرَادَ الْحَجَّ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: «إِنَّهُ يَحْضُرُ الْبَيْتَ مُشْرِكُونَ يَطُوفُونَ بِالْبَيْتِ عُرَاةً، فَلَا أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَحُجَّ حَتَّى أَحُجَّ وَلَيْسَ مَعِي مُشْرِكٌ» فَأَرْسَلَ أَبَا بَكْرِ بْنَ أَبِي قُحَافَةَ وَعَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، فَطَافَا بِالنَّاسِ بِذِي الْمَجَازِ وَبِأَمْكِنَتِهِمُ الَّتِي كَانُوا يَتَبَايَعُونَ بِهَا كُلِّهَا وَبِالْمَوْسِمِ كُلِّهِ فَآذَنُوا أَصْحَابَ الْعَهْدِ أَنْ يَأْمَنُوا أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ، وَهِيَ الْأَشْهُرُ الْحُرُمُ الْمُنْسَلِخَاتُ الْمُتَوَالِيَاتُ ⦗ص: 364⦘ عِشْرُونَ مِنْ آخِرِ ذِي الْحِجَّةِ إِلَى عَشْرٍ يَخْلُونَ مِنْ رَبِيعٍ الْآخَرَ أَنْ لَا عَهْدَ لَهُمْ، فَآذَنَ النَّاسَ كُلَّهُمْ بِالْقِتَالِ إِلَّا أَنْ يُؤْمِنُوا "
Edition record 372277 · p. 363Link to report ↗
02
Report from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr 02

Saʿīd ibn Jubayr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, Ibrahim related to us, Adam related to us, Warqa related to us, from Sulayman al-Shaybani, from Said ibn Jubayr, who said:
"It is the Day of Sacrifice."
العربية
الإسناد
أَنْبَأَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، ثنا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ:
«هُوَ يَوْمُ النَّحْرِ»
Edition record 372278 · p. 364Link to report ↗
03
Report from Ibn Abī Awfā 03

Ibn Abī Awfā

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, Ibrahim related to us, Adam related to us, Hushaym and Warqa related to us, from Sulayman al-Shaybani, from Ibn Abi Awfa, who said:
"The Day of Sacrifice, meaning: the day of the greater pilgrimage."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، ثنا آدَمُ ثنا هُشَيْمٌ، وَوَرْقَاءُ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي أَوْفَى، قَالَ:
" يَوْمُ النَّحْرِ يَعْنِي: يَوْمَ الْحَجِّ الْأَكْبَرِ "
Edition record 372279 · p. 364Link to report ↗

03

“And if any one of the polytheists seeks your protection, grant him…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 9:6).

05
Explanation from Mujāhid 05

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, Ibrahim related to us, Adam related to us, Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
And if any one of the polytheists seeks your protection, grant him protection [al-Tawba 6] He says: "a person who comes and hears what you say and hears what was revealed to you is safe until he hears the word of God and until he reaches his place of safety from where he came."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، ثنا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ،
وَإِنْ أَحَدٌ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ اسْتَجَارَكَ فَأَجِرْهُ [التوبة: 6] يَقُولُ: «إِنْسَانٌ يَأْتِي فَيَسْمَعُ مَا تَقُولُ وَيَسْمَعُ مَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْكَ فَهُوَ آمِنٌ حَتَّى يَسْمَعَ كَلَامَ اللَّهِ، وَحَتَّى يَبْلُغَ مَأْمَنَهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ جَاءَ»
Edition record 372281 · p. 364Link to report ↗
04

“They have exchanged the verses of God for a small price”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 9:9).

06
Explanation from Mujāhid 06

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, Ibrahim related to us, Adam related to us, Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, ⦗p. 365⦘ on His words:
They have exchanged the verses of God for a small price [al-Tawba 9] he said: "It is Abu Sufyan ibn Harb, who fed his allies and left the allies of Muhammad ﷺ."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، ثنا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، ⦗ص: 365⦘ فِي قَوْلِهِ:
اشْتَرَوْا بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ ثَمَنَا قَلِيلًا [التوبة: 9] قَالَ: «هُوَ أَبُو سُفْيَانَ بْنُ حَرْبٍ أَطْعَمَ حُلَفَاءَهُ، وَتَرَكَ حُلَفَاءَ مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ»
Edition record 372282 · p. 364Link to report ↗

“and they planned to expel the Messenger”

09
Explanation from Mujāhid 09

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, Adam related to us, Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and they planned to expel the Messenger [al-Tawba 13] he said: "from among them, and they expelled him"; "and they began [the fight] with you the first time" meaning: "Quraysh, when they fought the allies of Muhammad ﷺ."

الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ،
وَهَمُّوا بِإِخْرَاجِ الرَّسُولِ [التوبة: 13] قَالَ: «مِنْ بَيْنَ أَظْهُرِهِمْ فَأَخْرَجُوهُ» وَهُمْ بَدَءُوكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ يَعْنِي: «قُرَيْشًا حِينَ قَاتَلُوا حُلَفَاءَ مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ»

09

“Have you made the giving of water to pilgrims and the maintenance of…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 9:19, 9:23, 9:24).

11
Explanation from Mujāhid 11

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, Ibrahim related to us, Adam related to us, Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
Have you made the giving of water to pilgrims and the maintenance of the Sacred Mosque [al-Tawba 19], he said: "When they were commanded to emigrate, ⦗p. 366⦘ al-Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib said: 'I give the pilgrims water,' and Talha, brother of the Banu Abd al-Dar, said: 'I am the keeper of the Kaba, so I will not emigrate.' So there was revealed: O you who believe, do not take your fathers and your brothers as allies [al-Tawba 23] up to His words: then wait until God brings about His command [al-Tawba 24]."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
أَجَعَلْتُمْ سِقَايَةَ الْحَاجِّ، وَعِمَارَةَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ [التوبة: 19] ، قَالَ: " لَمَّا أُمِرُوا بِالْهِجْرَةِ، ⦗ص: 366⦘ قَالَ الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ: أَنَا أَسْقِي الْحَاجَّ، وَقَالَ طَلْحَةُ أَخُو بَنِي عَبْدِ الدَّارِ: أَنَا أَحْجُبُ الْكَعْبَةَ فَلَا أُهَاجِرُ، فَنَزَلَ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَتَّخِذُوا آبَاءَكُمْ وَإِخْوَانَكُمْ أَوْلِيَاءَ [التوبة: 23] إِلَى قَوْلِهِ فَتَرَبَّصُوا حَتَّى يَأْتِيَ اللَّهُ بِأَمْرِهِ [التوبة: 24] "
Edition record 372287 · p. 365Link to report ↗
10

“then wait until God brings about His command”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 9:24).

12
Explanation from Mujāhid 12

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, Ibrahim related to us, Adam related to us, Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
then wait until God brings about His command [al-Tawba 24] he said: "He means the conquest, the conquest of Mecca, and this was when they were commanded to emigrate. What al-Abbas and Talha said, and all this, was before the conquest of Mecca."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
فَتَرَبَّصُوا حَتَّى يَأْتِيَ اللَّهُ بِأَمْرِهِ [التوبة: 24] قَالَ: " يَعْنِي بِالْفَتْحِ فَتْحَ مَكَّةَ، وَهَذَا حِينَ أُمِرُوا بِالْهِجْرَةِ، قَالَ الْعَبَّاسُ: وَطَلْحَةُ مَا قَالَا وَهَذَا كُلُّهُ قَبْلَ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ "
Edition record 372288 · p. 366Link to report ↗
11

“God has already given you victory in many regions”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 9:25).

13
Explanation from Mujāhid 13

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, Ibrahim related to us, Adam related to us, Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
God has already given you victory in many regions [al-Tawba 25], he said: "This is the first part revealed of Bara'a [al-Tawba]; He lets them know His victory and prepares them, or settles them, for the expedition of Tabuk."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
لَقَدْ نَصَرَكُمُ اللَّهُ فِي مَوَاطِنَ كَثِيرَةٍ [التوبة: 25] ، قَالَ: «هَذَا أَوَّلُ مَا نَزَلَ مِنْ بَرَاءَةَ يُعَرِّفُهُمْ نَصْرَهُ وَيُوَطِّئُهُمْ أَوْ يُوَطِّنُهُمْ لِغَزْوَةِ تَبُوكَ»

12

“And if you fear poverty, then God will enrich you from His bounty”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 9:28).

14
Explanation from Mujāhid 14

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, Ibrahim related to us, Adam related to us, Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
And if you fear poverty, then God will enrich you from His bounty [al-Tawba 28], the Muslims said: "We used to gain from the trade of the polytheists," so He promised to enrich them from His bounty as compensation for them, so long as the polytheists did not approach the Sacred Mosque after this year of theirs. This verse is with the beginning of Bara'a in recitation, and with its end in interpretation.
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ عَيْلَةً فَسَوْفَ يُغْنِيكُمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ [التوبة: 28] قَالَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ: «كُنَّا نُصِيبُ مِنْ مَتَاجِرِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ، فَوَعَدَهُمْ أَنْ يُغْنِيَهُمْ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ عِوَضًا لَهُمْ بِأَلَّا يَقْرَبَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ الْمَسْجِدَ الْحَرَامَ بَعْدَ عَامِهِمْ هَذَا، فَهَذِهِ الْآيَةُ مَعَ أَوَّلِ بَرَاءَةَ فِي الْقِرَاءَةِ وَمَعَ آخِرِهَا فِي التَّأْوِيلِ»

15
Explanation from Mujāhid 15

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, Ibrahim related to us, Adam related to us, Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
Fight those who do not believe in God or in the Last Day [al-Tawba 29] up to His words: until they give the jizya willingly while they are humbled [al-Tawba 29], he said: "This was revealed when the Prophet ﷺ and his companions were commanded to the expedition of Tabuk."
العربية
الإسناد

قَاتِلُوا الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَلَا بِالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ [التوبة: 29] إِلَى قَوْلِهِ: حَتَّى يُعْطُوا الْجِزْيَةَ عَنْ يَدٍ وَهُمْ صَاغِرُونَ [التوبة: 29] ، قَالَ: «نَزَلَ هَذَا حِينَ أُمِرَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ وَأَصْحَابُهُ بِغَزْوَةِ تَبُوكَ»

Explanation from Abū al-Bakhtarī 16

Abū al-Bakhtarī

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ata ibn al-Sa'ib, from Abu al-Bakhtari, on His words:
They have taken their rabbis and monks as lords besides God [al-Tawba 31], he said: "They obeyed them in what they commanded them of God's forbidden and permitted things, so God made their obedience to them worship."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ، عَنْ أَبِي الْبُخْتُرِيِّ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
اتَّخَذُوا أَحْبَارَهُمْ وَرُهْبَانَهُمْ أَرْبَابًا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ [التوبة: 31] قَالَ: «أَطَاعُوهُمْ فِيمَا أَمَرُوهُمْ بِهِ مِنْ حَرَامِ اللَّهِ وَحَلَالِهِ فَجَعَلَ اللَّهُ طَاعَتَهُمْ لَهُمْ عِبَادَةً»

15

“And those who hoard gold and silver and do not ⦗p. 368⦘ spend it in…”

An explanation transmitted from Zayd ibn Wahb (Q 9:34).

17
Explanation from Zayd ibn Wahb 17

Zayd ibn Wahb

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Husayn ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Zayd ibn Wahb, who said:
I passed by al-Rabadha and said to Abu Dharr al-Ghifari: "What brought you down here?" He said: "I was in Syria," and I recited this verse: And those who hoard gold and silver and do not ⦗p. 368⦘ spend it in the cause of God, give them tidings of a painful punishment [al-Tawba 34]. A man said: "This verse is only for the People of the Book, and not about us." I said: "It is about us and about them." So I settled in this place. By God, I will not abandon what I said, even if an Abyssinian slave were placed in authority over me, I would not disobey him.
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنْ حُصَيْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ: مَرَرْتُ بِالرَّبَذَةَ فَقُلْتُ لِأَبِي ذَرٍّ الْغِفَارِيِّ: مَا أَنْزَلَكَ هَهُنَا؟ فَقَالَ:
«إِنِّي كُنْتُ بِالشَّامِ» فَقَرَأْتُ هَذِهِ الْآيَةَ وَالَّذِينَ يَكْنِزُونَ الذَّهَبَ وَالْفِضَّةَ وَلَا ⦗ص: 368⦘ يُنْفِقُونَهَا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَبَشِّرْهُمْ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍّ [التوبة: 34] فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ: إِنَّمَا هَذِهِ الْآيَةُ لِأَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ وَلَيْسَتْ فِينَا، فَقُلْتُ: هِيَ فِينَا وَفِيهِمْ، فَنَزَلْتُ هَذَا الْمَنْزِلَ، فَوَاللَّهِ لَا أَدَعُ مَا قُلْتُ وَلَوْ أُمِّرَ عَلَيَّ عَبْدٌ حَبَشِيٌّ مَا عَصَيْتُهُ "

17

“What is the matter with you that when you are told to go forth in…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 9:38).

19
Explanation from Mujāhid 19

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
What is the matter with you that when you are told to go forth in the cause of God you cling heavily to the earth? [al-Tawba 38] he said: "This was when they were commanded to the expedition of Tabuk, after the conquest, after al-Taif, and after Hunayn. They were commanded to march in the summer, when the dates were being gathered, the fruit was good, shade was desirable, and leaving was hard for them."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
مَا لَكُمْ إِذَا قِيلَ لَكُمُ انْفِرُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ اثَّاقَلْتُمْ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ [التوبة: 38] قَالَ: «هَذَا حِينَ أُمِرُوا بِغَزْوَةِ تَبُوكَ بَعْدَ الْفَتْحِ وَبَعْدَ الطَّائِفِ وَبَعْدَ حُنَيْنٍ، أُمِرُوا بِالنَّفْرِ فِي الصَّيْفِ حِينَ خَرِفْتَ النَّخْلُ، وَطَابَ الثَّمَرُ، وَاشْتُهِيَتِ الظِّلَالُ، وَشَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ الْخُرُوجُ»

Explanation from Mujāhid 21

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, who said:

العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
" لَمَّا اسْتَنْفَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ النَّاسَ إِلَى تَبُوكَ، قَالُوا: فِينَا الثَّقِيلُ وَذُو الْحَاجَةِ وَالضَّيْعَةِ وَالْمُنْتَشِرُ أَمْرُهُ وَالشُّغُلُ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عز وجل انْفِرُوا خِفَافًا وَثِقَالًا [التوبة: 41] "

20

“May God pardon you; why did you give them permission before it was…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 9:43, 9:91).

22
Explanation from Mujāhid 22

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
May God pardon you; why did you give them permission before it was clear to you who were truthful and you knew the liars? [al-Tawba 43]. That is because some people said: "Ask the Messenger for permission; if he permits you, stay behind, and if he does not permit you, march out." Mujahid said on His words: May God pardon you; why did you give them permission [al-Tawba 43] up to His words there is no way against the doers of good [al-Tawba 91]: "What lies between them concerns the hypocrites."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
عَفَا اللَّهُ عَنْكَ لِمَ أَذِنْتَ لَهُمْ حَتَّى يَتَبَيَّنَ لَكَ الَّذِينَ صَدَقُوا وَتَعْلَمَ الْكَاذِبِينَ [التوبة: 43] وَذَلِكَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ نَاسٌ: " اسْتَأْذِنُوا الرَّسُولَ، فَإِنْ أَذِنَ لَكُمْ فَاقْعُدُوا، وَإِنْ لَمْ يَأْذَنْ لَكُمْ فَانْفِرُوا. قَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ فِي قَوْلِهِ: عَفَا اللَّهُ عَنْكَ لِمَ أَذِنْتَ لَهُمْ [التوبة: 43] إِلَى قَوْلِهِ مَا عَلَى الْمُحْسِنِينَ مِنْ سَبِيلٍ [التوبة: 91] «مَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِي الْمُنَافِقِينَ»
Edition record 372298 · p. 369Link to report ↗

English

Two explanations transmitted from al-Ḥasan and Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 9:113, 9:114).

45
Explanation from al-Ḥasan 45

al-Ḥasan

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: al-Mubarak ibn Fudala related to us, from al-Hasan, who said:
It was said to the Prophet ﷺ: "So-and-so is asking forgiveness for his polytheist parents." He said: "And we ask forgiveness for our polytheist fathers." So God revealed: It is not for the Prophet and those who believe to ask forgiveness ⦗p. 376⦘ for the polytheists [al-Tawba 113] up to His words but when it became clear to him that he was an enemy to God, he disassociated himself from him [al-Tawba 114]. "So they refrained from asking forgiveness for them."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا الْمُبَارَكُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ: قِيلَ لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ: إِنَّ فُلَانًا يَسْتَغْفِرُ لِأَبَوَيْهِ الْمُشْرِكَيْنِ، قَالَ:
«وَنَحْنُ نَسْتَغْفِرُ لِآبَائِنَا الْمُشْرِكِينَ» ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ مَا كَانَ لِلنَّبِيِّ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَنْ يَسْتَغْفِرُوا ⦗ص: 376⦘ لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ [التوبة: 113] إِلَى قَوْلِهِ فَلَمَّا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُ أَنَّهُ عَدُوٌّ لِلَّهِ تَبَرَّأَ مِنْهُ [التوبة: 114] «فَأَمْسَكُوا عَنِ الِاسْتِغْفَارِ لَهُمْ»

43

“And it is not for the believers to go forth all together. Why should…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 9:122).

49
Explanation from Mujāhid 49

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
And it is not for the believers to go forth all together. Why should there not go forth from every division of them a group [al-Tawba 122]. "That is because some of the companions of the Prophet ﷺ went out into the desert regions and found among the people kindness and abundance from which they benefited, and they called those they found among the people to guidance. The people said to them: 'We see that you have left your companion and come to us.' They felt some discomfort about that in themselves, and all came back from the desert until they entered upon the Prophet ﷺ." So God ⦗p. 378⦘ Mighty and Majestic said: Why should there not go forth from every division [al-Tawba 122] meaning: "some go and some stay"; to become learned [al-Tawba 122]: "and hear what is among the people and what is revealed after them"; and to warn their people [al-Tawba 122] meaning: "to warn all the people when they return to them, that perhaps they will beware."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَمَا كَانَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ لِيَنْفِرُوا كَافَّةً فَلَوْلَا نَفَرَ مِنْ كُلِّ فِرْقَةٍ مِنْهُمْ طَائِفَةٌ [التوبة: 122] " وَذَلِكَ أَنَّ نَاسًا مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ خَرَجُوا فِي الْبَوَادِي فَأَصَابُوا مِنَ النَّاسِ مَعْرُوفًا وَمِنَ الْخِصْبِ مَا يَنْتَفِعُونَ بِهِ، وَدَعُوا مَنْ وَجَدُوا مِنَ النَّاسِ إِلَى الْهُدَى، فَقَالَ لَهُمُ النَّاسُ: مَا نَرَاكُمْ إِلَّا قَدْ تَرَكْتُمْ صَاحِبَكُمْ وَجِئْتُمُونَا، فَوَجَدُوا مِنْ ذَلِكَ فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ تَحَرُّجًا، وَأَقْبَلُوا مِنَ الْبَادِيَةِ كُلِّهِمْ حَتَّى دَخَلُوا عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ "، فَقَالَ اللَّهُ ⦗ص: 378⦘ عز وجل: فَلَوْلَا نَفَرَ مِنْ كُلِّ فِرْقَةٍ [التوبة: 122] يَعْنِي: «بَعْضًا وَيَقْعُدُ بَعْضٌ» . لِيَتَفَقَّهُوا [التوبة: 122] «وَلِيَسْمَعُوا مَا فِي النَّاسِ وَمَا أَنْزَلَ بَعْدَهُمْ» . وَلِيُنْذِرُوا قَوْمَهُمْ [التوبة: 122] يَعْنِي: «لِيُنْذِرُوا النَّاسَ كُلَّهُمْ إِذَا رَجَعُوا إِلَيْهِمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَحْذَرُونَ»
